name: PCA
description: Principal component analysis of one or more numeric columns by the covariance matrix and a Jacobi eigen decomposition. scores mode appends pc1..pcN to the input, loadings mode returns one row per component and column, and explained mode returns the eigenvalue, the explained-variance fraction and the cumulative fraction per component. Features are optionally z-score standardized; the sign of every component is fixed so its largest absolute loading is positive.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Numeric columns the components are computed on; at least one.

components.title: Components
components.description: Number of principal components to return; must not exceed the number of selected columns.

standardize.title: Standardize
standardize.description: Z-score every feature before the decomposition; a constant column becomes zero.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: scores appends pc1..pcN to the input rows, loadings returns one row per component and column, explained returns the eigenvalue and variance fractions per component.

max_rows.title: Maximum rows
max_rows.description: The fit reads complete rows into memory and supports at most this many; a larger input is an error with a hint to raise the cap or pre-filter.
